adds.title: Studie zu Lebenslagen und Erfahrungen von LSBTIQ* „Queer durch NRW“ (Ministerium für Kinder, Jugend, Familie, Gleichstellung, Flucht und Integration NRW / chancen.nrw)
adds.summary: The North Rhine-Westphalian state ministry page records that on 25 April 2025 the Land government published the study „Queer durch NRW – Lebenslagen und Erfahrungen von LSBTIQ*“, the first comprehensive dataset on the living situations of lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans*, inter*, queer and non-binary people (LSBTIQ*) in the Land. The study combined quantitative online surveys — more than 5,000 LSBTIQ* respondents, 775 relatives and over 5,000 professionals — with qualitative focus groups and expert interviews, covering three areas: discrimination, violence and safety; health, care and ageing; and integration, migration and flight. It was commissioned under Landtag resolution Drucksache 18/6360 to develop the state's „Aktionsplan für Vielfalt und gegen Homo- und Transfeindlichkeit“ on a broader data basis. This gives the record its first genuinely Nordrhein-Westfalen-specific source with Land-level findings on discrimination, violence and safety affecting trans* people — relevant to visitor exposure because the Land enacted no trans statute and the state's anti-homo/transphobia action plan now rests on this data.
